question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: the

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the proper use of these given articles. 
 
 
• The indefinite article (**A**) is used before a noun that is general or when its identity is not known. "**A**" goes before words that begin with consonants.
 
• The indefinite article (**An**) is used before a noun that is general or when its identity is not known. "**An**" goes before words that begin with vowels.
 
• 'Any' means one or some or every or all without specification.
 
• The definite article (**The**) is used before a noun to indicate that the identity of the noun is known to the reader.
 
 
 
• **World **(noun) means the planet on which human/animal life has developed, especially including all people/animals and their ways of life.
 
• Therefore, 'the' should be used.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Complete passage: *Finland is a country of vast green forests, beautiful Baltic islands, windswept Arctic mountains and (1) countless __blue lakes. These pristine and picturesque landscapes (2) __provide __a habitat for many wild animals and birds including (3) *__magnificent __*bears, wolves, eagles, cranes and swans, as well as **(4) __the __**world’s rarest seals. Birdwatchers flock to Finland to find (5) ________ that are hard to spot anywhere else in Europe. Keen wildlife photographers (6)_______ come here to enjoy excursions and facilities that enable (7) ________ to get spectacular shots of the amazing animals in their (8) _______ settings. Some of the great places to preserve these (9) ________ include Finland’s forty national parks, which are open to (10) _______ all year round.*
